
---

### Download

| Your Mac | File |
|---|---|
| Apple silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4…) | **Freemiere-Pro-arm64.dmg** |
| Intel | **Freemiere-Pro-x64.dmg** |

Not sure? Open  menu → **About This Mac** and look at **Chip** / **Processor**.

**First launch:** Freemiere Pro is not notarized by Apple. After dragging it to Applications, Control-click the app → **Open**, or go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**. If macOS says the app is damaged, run:

```bash
xattr -cr "/Applications/Freemiere Pro.app"
```

**Already installed?** Use **Freemiere Pro → Check for Updates…** — the app downloads and installs this release for you.
